meta.title: An expired or absent token is refused everywhere
gaps: Unauthenticated and corrupted-credential requests cannot be represented because operations do not support removing or overriding credentials.
The requested /api/event_groups routes are not among the allowed request routes.
No operation can issue POST /api/event_groups without required setup identifiers and fields.
POST /v1/bids is available only through authenticated bid operations or library cases, so its authentication refusal cannot be isolated.
